title: Adapter block (the fenced discover-adapter JSON in adapters/<project-id>.md)

project.description: The project ID: the registry entry's file name.

as_of.description: The commit the adapter describes. Donors compare the paths it names against this commit to spot drift.

paths.description: Repo paths the adapter relies on, checked for changes since as_of.commit.

manifest.description: Where things live, in discover.json's shape. Used only while the repo has no discover.json.

frontier_doc.description: Where the project states its current result when it isn't (only) machine-readable. Stands in for the manifest's frontier for listing.

note.description: How to read it, in the project's own terms.

frontier_adapter.description: Maps the repo's own results record onto frontier fields: {v0_field: raw_field}, plus metric, a declared evidence_level, and optionally select {list, key, current} to read the entry a registry's current field names.
